verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a headless mode for scripts, bots and machine-friendly tasks, with plain, json and streaming-json output formats, an ACP JSON-RPC stdin/stdout mode, and device-code auth for headless or remote environments. A community commenter independently confirms headless mode (-p) is used for scripts and automations. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. CI runner/GitHub Actions setup or key-based non-interactive auth), clear documentation of how permission prompts are handled unattended (Auto mode notes dangerous tools may still prompt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.
This runs Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout.
`--device-auth` uses device-code authentication for headless or remote environments
headless mode (-p) for scripts and automations
